page.title: Upload
page.metaDescription: Drag, drop, or paste files. Resumable uploads built for multi-GB files.
page.lead: Drag files anywhere in the panel and they land in the folder you have open. Uploads resume automatically if your connection drops, so multi-GB files survive a bad line.

resume.title: Resumes on drop-out
resume.body: Lose your connection mid-transfer? It picks up from the last chunk, with no restart.

huge.title: Built for huge files
huge.body: Multi-GB videos and archives upload in chunks, kept stable end to end.

anywhere.title: Drop anywhere
anywhere.body: Drop files onto any panel page, or paste a screenshot straight from your clipboard.

dashboardNote: Drag, drop, or paste from your clipboard. Any size, any type, and uploads resume on their own.

target.library: New files land in your library
target.unsorted: New files land outside any folder

standard.title: Standard upload
standard.hint: Resumable, previewable, convertible. The server can read the file.

encrypted.title: End-to-end encrypted
encrypted.hint: Encrypted in this tab before it leaves. We never see the file or the key.

deal.title: What you get, and what you give up
deal.link: The key travels inside the link, in the part after the hash. Browsers never send that part to a server, so it never reaches us.
deal.lost: Whoever holds the link holds the key. Lose the link and the file is gone: we cannot recover it for you.
deal.leaks: We still see the size, the time and the account it belongs to. The filename and the file type are encrypted with the contents.
deal.noPreview: No thumbnails, no moving previews, no format conversion. All of those need the file, and we do not have it.
deal.tab: Keep this tab open until the upload finishes. The key lives only here, so a reload cancels the transfer.

encrypted.dashboardNote: Encrypted in your browser before a single byte is sent. Any size, any type.
